answer: Rotating Shard Assignment. Each epoch, a public zephyr beacon (drand round) shuffles agents into shards and assigns each a random duty slot; only shardmates can transact. An attacker must place sybils in many shards, so each identity needs its own key, bandwidth, and timely beacon-triggered response—costs scaling per duplicate. Late responses are timber-penalized (duty forfeited). Like shale layers, slots reseed unpredictably, blocking precomputation.
